data.title: 圣女贞德 · 夜市可丽饼的约会·「原来甜食……是这么幸福的东西啊」
data.description: 【灯火通明的夜市街角·夜晚】贞德双手捧着一块涂满草莓与奶油的可丽饼，小心翼翼地咬下第一口——下一瞬，她的眼睛倏地睁大，金色的眉毛幸福地舒展开来。身着便服披肩的她全然不顾圣女形象地小口小口吃着，嘴角沾上一点奶油也浑然不觉。夜市的暖红灯笼在她紫蓝色的眼眸里跳动，映出满溢的、毫无防备的幸福。
data.action: 双手捧可丽饼小口品尝，眼睛惊喜睁大，嘴角沾着奶油浑然不觉
data.lighting: 暖红灯笼串光与摊位蒸汽暖光笼罩侧脸
data.camera: medium close-up, holding crepe, lantern bokeh, delighted expression
data.promptProse: Jeanne holds a paper-wrapped strawberry crepe in both hands at the night market, pausing after her first bite with surprised violet-blue eyes and an unnoticed cream spot at her mouth. A soft shawl covers her white blouse above the blue skirt, golden braid over one shoulder. The medium close-up includes evening stalls receding behind. Warm red lanterns light her face and crepe wrapper, with stall light catching rising steam beside her.
